name: AYE FINANCE LIMITED
summary: Aye Finance Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides loans to micro, small, and medium enterprises in India. The company offers a range of business loans for working capital and business expansion needs against hypothecation of working assets or against security of property to customers across manufacturing, trading, service, and allied agriculture sectors. It also provides mortgage and emergency credit line guarantee scheme loans; shakti loans for women-led businesses; and SwitchPe, a supply chain finance platform. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Gurugram, India.
